description: This file contains implementation of test SSL private key classes and functions for wrapping OpenSSL private keys, including a test delegate and a failing delegate, used within the Chromium project's net/ssl module.

classes.name: TestSSLPlatformKey
classes.description: A delegate class implementing signing operations using EVP_PKEY for testing purposes.

classes.name: FailingSSLPlatformKey
classes.description: A delegate class that always fails signing, used for testing failure scenarios.

methods.name: WrapOpenSSLPrivateKey
methods.description: Wraps an EVP_PKEY into a ThreadedSSLPrivateKey object.

methods.name: WrapRSAPrivateKey
methods.description: Wraps an RSA private key into an SSLPrivateKey object.

methods.name: CreateFailSigningSSLPrivateKey
methods.description: Creates an SSLPrivateKey that always fails signing.
